Unmaterialized backed readers can suspend with validation state and restore without losing logical admission. EOF merges cold and resident streams in legacy key order; reset retires reader tasks. Materialization reserves encoded row size plus 256 bytes per fragment and raw payload credits; loaded-reader appends reserve credits too. CLI defaults are 64 MiB TCP payload, 32 MiB reassembly pages and 64 MiB TCP state; zero remains unlimited. Finite state limits reduce each pool's hot candidate target
